name: onboarding-webapp

dependencies.name: onboarding-api
dependencies.description: Calls the onboarding API for new hires, checklist tasks, the template and notifications.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs in HR Coordinator, IT Staff, Facilities Staff and New Hire users via the platform IDP.

description: The single web app for the onboarding tracker: HR Coordinator screens (add new hire, edit template, cross-department progress), department task queues for IT and Facilities staff, and a read-only checklist view for new hires. Does not send email or store data of its own — all state lives in onboarding-api.
